span.p:
Kafka
ginti likhi, redirect dheema
-> 302 turant do, ek click hua Kafka (disk pe log) me daalo
Analytics apni speed se padhe, kahan tak padha yaad (Kafka, offset)
Analytics dheema -> khabar Kafka me padi rahe
Kafka band -> redirect chalta, kuch ginti gayi
wahi click do baar -> click id se ek hi (dedupe)
kharab khabar -> alag line (DLQ), baaki chalti
